title: Proposals
subtitle: Review AI proposals and record your decision.
emptyHint: Ask AI to create a proposal to track its review and decision here.
noReviews: This proposal has no reviews yet.
decisionHint: This records your decision. You can then ask AI to carry out approved work.
reviewRequired: Approval or rejection requires a review of the current revision.
exportPending: Your decision was saved, but the Markdown backup has not been updated yet.
terminal: A decision is recorded for this revision. Ask AI to revise it if the proposal needs further consideration.
reasonPlaceholder: Reasons to proceed, concerns, or missing information
reconsider: When or under what conditions to reconsider
required: You can leave the reason blank. To hold a proposal, provide a next action, owner, and reconsideration condition.
promptHint: Copy this into a conversation with an AI that has KB access.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the request text and copy it manually.

prompts.create: Use ordinary KB search to find related decisions and knowledge, and retrieve relevant notes in full. If an existing proposal is specified, explicitly retrieve its ID with get_proposal as material for proposal review. Unapproved proposals are excluded from ordinary search. Turn the idea I describe next into a proposal ticket with create_proposal. Specify the problem, proposed action, impact, acceptance criteria, and scope. Ask for missing required information first. Do not change existing note statuses or implement changes before review and my decision.
prompts.review: Explicitly retrieve proposal {{note}} (UID: {{uid}}), including its full content, history, and etag, with get_proposal. Treat the current revision as a proposal under review. Assess benefits, risks and uncertainties, alternatives, and a recommendation. Record the review with review_proposal using the retrieved etag. Use ordinary KB search and full retrieval for supporting notes. Do not apply an unapproved proposal as adopted guidance, implement changes, or record a human decision.
prompts.revise: Explicitly retrieve proposal {{note}} (UID: {{uid}}), including its full content, history, and etag, with get_proposal. Review its feedback and decision reasons as material for considering the proposal. Confirm the proposed revision with me, then create a new revision using revise_proposal and the retrieved etag. Preserve earlier reviews and decisions and restart at review. Do not apply an unapproved proposal as adopted guidance or implement changes.

confirmationDescription: This decision will be recorded with the details below.
confirmationChanged: The proposal changed. Review its latest content before deciding.
